title: QUIC RFC 9000 S4P6 Max Streams Oversized Close Policy Tail
purpose: Describe the focused S4P6 closure for oversized max_streams transport-parameter and MAX_STREAMS frame close behavior.
design_summary: Transport-parameter and MAX_STREAMS frame values are bounded at 2^60. Valid boundary values are accepted and committed, while oversized typed transport-parameter values fail closed with TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR and malformed protected MAX_STREAMS application frames fail closed with FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR.
data_and_state_considerations: Peer initial max_streams values are validated before being committed to the stream registry so invalid typed TLS bridge inputs cannot inflate peer stream limits. The protected Application Data parser identifies malformed MAX_STREAMS frame types even when full frame parsing fails and carries the triggering frame type into the close metadata.
edge_cases_and_constraints: The 2^60 initial max_streams transport-parameter boundary commits without closing.
An initial max_streams value above 2^60 closes through TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR before stream-limit mutation.
A protected Application Data MAX_STREAMS frame carrying a value above 2^60 closes through FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR for both bidirectional and unidirectional frame types.
risks: This slice does not add automatic stream-limit autotuning.
This slice does not broaden public stream API support.
The S4P6-0006 and S4P6-0007 fuzz expectations remain deferred.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This design closes the S4P6 max_streams oversized close-policy tail for RFC9000-S4-6-P2-S1-R01 and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0007 only. It does not claim cumulative incoming-stream admission proof, metadata-only S4P6 xref cleanup, automatic stream-limit autotuning, public API widening, hosted interop readiness, or closure of deferred fuzz obligations.
